cards.universe: proxy Russell 2000 deletions (total-cap rank 1,200-2,900 last year, >= 3,200 this year)
cards.data_needed: daily bars, EDGAR shares (mcap_pit), splits, 8-K items
cards.rule: Buy stocks forced out of the Russell 2000 at the open after recon day; hold 20 sessions.

cards.universe: proxy Russell 2000 additions (rank > 3,100 last year, 1,300-2,800 this year)
cards.holding_period: rank day+1 open to recon-day close (~40 sessions)
cards.rule: Buy predicted microcap-to-R2000 additions after rank day; sell at the recon-day close.

cards.source: Ritter 1988; Lynch, Puckett & Yan 2014; Kozlowski & Lytle 2023
cards.rule: Buy the 30 worst YTD small/mid caps ten sessions before year end; sell after ten January sessions.

cards.source: Wang, Shin & Francis 2012 (JFQA); Hossain 2010; Knewtson & Nofsinger
cards.data_needed: daily bars, Form 4 (officer_title, cmp_labels), earnings dates
cards.rule: Buy two sessions after a CEO/CFO open-market purchase >= $25k is filed; hold five sessions.

cards.universe: all store stocks >= $5, med_dv_63 >= $1M, top 1% 12-month return
cards.data_needed: daily bars, point-in-time expected earnings dates
cards.rule: Buy top-1% 12-month winners four sessions before the expected report; sell the session before it.

cards.data_needed: daily bars, EDGAR sue and rev_surprise
cards.rule: Buy when both the earnings and revenue surprise of a new filing are in the top quintile; hold 63 sessions.

cards.source: Boudoukh, Michaely, Richardson & Roberts 2007; Meb Faber / Cambria SYLD
cards.data_needed: daily bars, dividends, EDGAR shares and OCF
cards.rule: Hold the small/mid caps with the highest dividend plus net buyback yield, monthly with a 10/20% band.

cards.source: Andreas Clenow, Stocks on the Move (2015)
cards.rule: Weekly, hold the top 20% by 90-day regression slope x R^2 above the 100-day with no 15% gap; buy only when SPY > 200-day; ATR sizing.

cards.data_needed: daily bars, EDGAR EPS, revenue, gross profit, OCF, assets, equity, shares
cards.rule: Monthly, buy cheap small/mid caps scoring >= 7 of 8 buildable Piotroski signals; sell below 6 or after 126 sessions.

cards.data_needed: daily bars, EDGAR quarterly EPS, revenue, shares, rs_rating_ibd
cards.rule: Buy when three quarters of accelerating EPS, sales and margin coincide with the trend template; exit below the 50-day.
Buy an up day whose volume beats every down day of the last 10, off the 10-day line in a stock above its 50-day; sell on the 7-week 10-day violation.
Buy the first close above an all-time high untouched for 3+ months; sell on a close back below it.

cards.source: Laurens Bensdorp, Automated Stock Trading Systems (2020)
cards.rule: After a 12.5% three-day drop above the 150-day, limit buy 7% under the close; 4% target, 3-day exit.

cards.source: Laurens Bensdorp, Automated Stock Trading Systems (2020)
cards.rule: With ADX(7) > 45, close >= SMA100 + ATR and RSI(3) <= 50, limit buy 4% under the close; 1.2 ATR target, 6-day exit.
After a stock doubles then falls 30% over 3+ red days, buy the first strong green close; sell the next close.

cards.source: Kim, Klein & Rosenfeld 2008; Lerman & Livnat 2010; Field & Hanka 2001
cards.rule: Refuse longs after a reverse split (1y), 8-K 1.03/3.01 (126 sessions), 5.02 (63), or near a likely IPO lockup expiry.
